contexts.text: These things appear as of no consequence to the man to whom worldly and bodily things are a matter of care and of the heart; but to the Angels they are precious... Hence it is manifest that many things which are of no consequence to man... are most highly valued by the Angels... and, on the other hand, that the things which are most highly valued by man... are of no consequence to the Angels. AC 2551:end. AC 2574:end.
Unless they were significative, these things would be of too slight consequence to be mentioned in the Divine Word.
Unstable as water = to be of no weight or strength. AE 434:17.
Truth from good is of such a nature that it ascends upwards, like a light body in the world.
A light cloud () = truth. ( = Divine truth natural spiritual. AE 654:48.)
Whose horses are swifter than leopards () = ... their skill in seducing. Their desire and skill are signified by their being light and swift.
